lines.en: Lesson 38
lines.zh: 第38课

lines.en: Water and the traveller
lines.zh: 水与旅行者

lines.en: What does this text describe?
lines.zh: 本文描述了什么？

lines.en: Contamination of water supplies is usually due to poor sanitation close to water sources,
lines.zh: 供水污染通常是由于水源附近卫生条件差，

lines.en: sewage disposal into the sources themselves, leakage of sewage into distribution systems or contamination with industrial or farm waste.
lines.zh: 污水直接排入水源，污水泄漏进入分配系统，或受到工业或农业废物的污染。

lines.en: Even if a piped water supply is safe at its source, it is not always safe by the time it reaches the tap.
lines.zh: 即使管道供水在其源头是安全的，但当它到达水龙头时，也并非总是安全的。

lines.en: Intermittent tap-water supplies should be regarded as particularly suspect.
lines.zh: 间歇性自来水供应应被视为特别可疑。

lines.en: Travellers on short trips to areas with water supplies of uncertain quality
lines.zh: 短途旅行到水质不确定地区的旅行者

lines.en: should avoid drinking tap-water, or untreated water from any other source.
lines.zh: 应避免饮用自来水，或任何其他来源的未经处理的水。

lines.en: It is best to keep to hot drinks, bottled or canned drinks of well-known brand names-international standard of water treatment are usually followed at bottling plants.
lines.zh: 最好只喝热饮、知名品牌的瓶装或罐装饮料——瓶装厂通常会遵循国际水处理标准。

lines.en: Carbonated drinks are acidic, and slightly safer.
lines.zh: 碳酸饮料呈酸性，稍微安全一些。

lines.en: Make sure that all bottles are opened in your presence, and that their rims are clean and dry.
lines.zh: 确保所有瓶子都是在你面前打开的，并且瓶口清洁干燥。

lines.en: Boiling is always a good way of treating water.
lines.zh: 煮沸始终是处理水的好方法。

lines.en: Some hotels supply boiled water on request and this can be used for drinking, or for brushing teeth.
lines.zh: 有些酒店应要求提供开水，可用于饮用或刷牙。

lines.en: Portable boiling elements that can boil small quantities of water are useful when the right voltage of electricity is available.
lines.zh: 当有合适的电压时，能烧开少量水的便携式电热棒会很有用。

lines.en: Refuse politely any cold drink from an unknown source.
lines.zh: 礼貌地拒绝任何来源不明的冷饮。

lines.en: Ice is only as safe as the water from which it is made,
lines.zh: 冰的安全性取决于制作它的水，

lines.en: and should not be put in drinks unless it is known to be safe.
lines.zh: 除非已知其安全，否则不应将其放入饮料中。

lines.en: Drinks can be cooled by placing them on ice rather than adding ice to them.
lines.zh: 饮料可以通过放在冰块上冷却，而不是将冰块加入饮料中。

lines.en: Alcohol may be a medical disinfectant, but should not be relied upon to sterilize water.
lines.zh: 酒精可能是医用消毒剂，但不应指望它能给水消毒。

lines.en: Ethanol is more effective at a concentration of 50-70 percent;
lines.zh: 乙醇在50-70%的浓度下更有效；

lines.en: below 20 per cent, its bactericidal action is negligible.
lines.zh: 低于20%时，其杀菌作用微乎其微。

lines.en: Spirits labelled 95 proof contain only about 47 per cent alcohol.
lines.zh: 标示为95度的烈酒只含有大约47%的酒精。

lines.en: Beware of methylated alcohol,
lines.zh: 警惕工业酒精（甲醇变性酒精），

lines.en: which is very poisonous and should never be added to drinking water.
lines.zh: 它剧毒，绝不应加入饮用水中。

lines.en: If no other safe water supply can be obtained,
lines.zh: 如果无法获得其他安全水源，

lines.en: tap water that is too hot to touch can be left to cool and is generally safe to drink.
lines.zh: 热得烫手的自来水可以放凉后饮用，通常是安全的。

lines.en: Those planning a trip to remote areas, or intending to live in countries where drinking water is not readily available,
lines.zh: 计划去偏远地区旅行，或打算生活在饮用水不易获得的国家的人，

lines.en: should know about the various possible methods for making water safe.
lines.zh: 应该了解使水安全可饮用的各种可能方法。
